title: nephrodium loherianum
intro: Nephrodium loherianum, commonly known as the Loher's maidenhair fern, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Nephrodium loherianum include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
